proves.claim: The adapter claim call passes the body's place to claimJob, and a claim without a place claims as today.

api.io-jobs-place.adapter-passes-place.why: Without this test the duplicate check never runs on the real claim path.

proves.claim: The offered shards of a gate whose candidate lacks the named main commit end as withdrawn with a detail naming it and the next step; claimed shards, current gates, release shards and unreadable candidates stay.

api.io-stale-shard-offers.ends-stale-off.why: Without this test, the coordinator's stale-shard ending could end claimed or current shards, or leave the stale ones holding runner time.

proves.claim: With dryRun the same gates and shards are returned and every shard stays offered.

api.io-stale-shard-offers.dry-run-ends-n.why: Without this test, a dry run could end shards the coordinator only meant to list.

proves.claim: A before git cannot resolve refuses STALE_BEFORE_UNKNOWN and ends nothing.

api.io-stale-shard-offers.unknown-commit.why: Without this test, a mistyped commit could read every candidate as stale and end every offered shard.

proves.claim: One call reads the job table once through an index on job_step and runs one ancestry check per distinct candidate.

api.io-stale-shard-offers.one-indexed-pa.why: Without this test, the call could scan the whole job table or spawn git once per shard on a board with thousands of jobs.

proves.claim: Once every shard is done the next runner claim settles the gate red, the item stays with its builder, and the red fact quotes the withdrawn detail.

api.io-stale-shard-offers.gate-settles-r.why: Without this test, a gate whose shards were ended could wait forever or tell its builder only that no proof phase ran.

proves.claim: The api front door exports duplicateRunnerPlaces as a function.

api.io-barrel-shape.exports-duplicate-ru.why: Without this test, the runner-places check landed in jobs.js could stay unreachable from the api front door.

proves.claim: A sharded gate whose only red shard fails only in a file main already fails, with the main comparison port given, settles green through the posted-receipt dispatch and appends one note fact naming the file as main-red.

api.io-gate.shard-main-red-settles-green.why: Without this test a red that main already owns blocks every item behind it until someone hand-lands.

proves.claim: A sharded gate whose red file main also fails, but which the submitted diff touches, still settles red through the posted-receipt dispatch and appends no main-red note.

api.io-gate.shard-red-in-item-diff-stays.why: Without this test an item that breaks a file main already fails would settle green and land the break.

proves.claim: A sharded gate with a failing case main does not fail, or with no comparison answer, still settles red and appends no main-red note.

api.io-gate.shard-red-outside-main-stays.why: Without this test the main-red settle could turn a real new red green.

proves.claim: A land job offered for a repository with check.install set carries that install command, trimmed, in its payload.

api.landing-install.offer-carries-instal.why: Without this test the land job never learns the install command and runs item checks in a checkout with no dependencies.

proves.claim: A repository with no check.install, or a blank one, offers a land payload with no install field.

api.landing-install.offer-without-instal.why: Without this test every land payload could grow an empty install and the runner would run a blank command.

proves.claim: A gate shard offer carries its ledger hits and, for each other file, why the ledger has no hit: none, red or changed.

api.io-gate.shard-offer-ledger-hits-and-.why: A runner miss the board cannot explain hides why a third of the proof reruns; the reason read from ledger rows says whether the file is new, red or its input key moved.

proves.claim: A shard red in the item's own cases ends the gate's other open shards and the red applies at once.

api.io-gate-fail-fast.item-red-ends-rema.why: A red gate that keeps its other shards running wastes runner minutes on proof the red already decided.

proves.claim: A shard red only in cases main also fails ends no other shard.

api.io-gate-fail-fast.main-red-ends-noth.why: A red gate that keeps its other shards running wastes runner minutes on proof the red already decided.

proves.claim: With gate.failFastShards off a red shard ends no other shard.

api.io-gate-fail-fast.setting-off-ends-n.why: A red gate that keeps its other shards running wastes runner minutes on proof the red already decided.

proves.claim: apiStatus answers a GITHUB_UNAVAILABLE refusal with HTTP 503 and a GITHUB_RATE_LIMITED refusal with HTTP 429.

api.io-barrel-shape.github-refusals-answ.why: Without this test a GitHub outage or rate limit reads as a bad request (400) and the caller stops retrying a call that would succeed later.

proves.claim: seedWideMainTests queues one main-test row per file red in the gates of 10 or more distinct items in the last 24 h, nothing more across separate opens of one board root at the same main sha, and seeds again for a new main sha.

api.io-recheck.seed-once-per-main.why: Without this test the seeded-at marker can key per db handle again, so every claim re-reads the job steps and stalls the board API.

proves.claim: A pull claim through boardJobQueueCall runs no seeding with gate.seedWideMainTests off, and with it on seeds once per board root and main sha.

api.io-recheck.claim-path-seeds-once.why: Without this test the claim path seeds on every claim or never, with the setting ignored.

proves.claim: shardJobs returns exactly one gate's shard rows in order, never a sibling gate's, and its query searches the job_id key instead of scanning every job row.

api.io-gate.shard-jobs-key-range.why: Without this test shardJobs can slide back to a substr scan of every gate-shard row on each pull claim, so claim cost grows with the number of gates.

proves.claim: With gate.seedWideMainTests on, the 24 h window is a bound inside the seeding SQL, and its query plan searches job by the job_kind_created index with no SCAN of job_step.

api.io-gate.seed-window-in-sql.why: Without this test the window can slide back into a JavaScript filter or the index can be dropped, so every seeding reads all receipts on a large board and stalls the board API.

proves.claim: With gate.seedWideMainTests on and main unmoved, a pull claim through boardJobQueueCall spawns no git process, and the main sha is computed once per main move.

api.io-gate.seed-claim-path-no-git.why: Without this test the claim path runs git on every claim, which the claim path must not.

proves.claim: An expedited item gets its gate shards before an aged test job and another item's older shards, and once it leaves the expedited set its leftover shards queue by age again.

api.jobs-claim-order.expedited-item-shar.why: Without this test, a regression in the claim order would leave an expedited item's gate waiting behind a backlog of older shards.
